summary_en: Operating margin target ≥6%; ROE to exceed shareholder cost of capital (5.0–8.0% CAPM); CCC to improve ≥50 days vs. FY3/26; equity ratio to move toward 60–65%; horizon FY3/28. Update to DKK-Plan2028 capital-allocation framework; enhanced IR and sustainability disclosure to improve PER and market valuation.
title_en: Response to Capital-Cost and Stock-Price-Conscious Management: Update
translation_en_brief:
On 27 August 2026, DKK Co., Ltd. updated its capital-allocation targets and cost-of-capital management plan. The company noted that PBR remains below 1.0x despite recent stock appreciation, and current ROE recovery trends require continued focus on operating profitability and capital efficiency. The company assessed its shareholder cost of capital at 5.0–8.0% (CAPM) and identified a negative equity spread, indicating gap between current valuation and market expectations.

Key targets through FY3/28 include: (1) operating margin of 6% or higher as the principal profitability driver; (2) ROE exceeding the cost of capital; (3) cash conversion cycle improvement of 50+ days versus FY3/26; and (4) equity ratio migration to the 60–65% band. The company will pursue these through strengthened revenue-generation capacity under its DKK-Plan2028 framework, optimized balance-sheet capital allocation, and enhanced investor relations and sustainability disclosure to improve PER and market perception.
